info.name: FinFlow API
info.description:
Every FinFlow endpoint, ordered so ids captured early are reused later.

Run the whole collection in order (Postman's Collection Runner, or newman).
Individual requests will 401 or 404 unless the auth folder has run first.

Generated by scripts/postman.js — regenerate with `npm run postman` rather
than editing this file, so it cannot drift from the API.
